ItemID: NA; Title: Goin' Home; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues guitar direction fits my Hendrix and Clapton listening, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: "Now" - Chicago XXXVI; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in bluesy guitar music than Chicago's horn-driven sound right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Johnny Winter's blues guitar feels like a strong match for my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Tom Petty feels especially relevant after You Should Be So Lucky; this is one I would try now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Black Crowes - Freak N Roll into the Fog; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their bluesy rock appeals to me, but I am not choosing a live album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Same Trailer Different Park; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away suggests some interest in country, but I am leaning toward rock and blues today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its mellow vocal approach is less appealing than guitar-led music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Crosseyed Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Keith Richards' rootsy rock sounds appealing, but I already have two stronger picks.
ItemID: NA; Title: Morning Phase; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not in the mood for a subdued, atmospheric album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loved Me Back to Life; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal pop is not what I am looking for on this visit.
